# AG-UI v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Elixir SDK for the AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction) protocol

## Pages

- [AG-UI Elixir SDK](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Contributing to AG-UI Elixir SDK](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- Core
  - [AgUi](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.md): AG-UI -- Elixir SDK for the Agent-User Interaction Protocol.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.md): All AG-UI protocol event types.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.md): Core type definitions for the AG-UI protocol.

- Event Types
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ActivityDelta](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ActivityDelta.md): Applies JSON Patch updates to an activity message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ActivitySnapshot](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ActivitySnapshot.md): Delivers a complete snapshot of an activity message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.Custom](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.Custom.md): Extension mechanism for application-specific events.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.EventType](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.EventType.md): All AG-UI event type constants.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.MessagesSnapshot](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.MessagesSnapshot.md): Delivers a complete history of conversation messages.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.Raw](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.Raw.md): Container for events from external systems.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningEncryptedValue](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningEncryptedValue.md): Attaches encrypted chain-of-thought to a message or tool call.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningEnd](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningEnd.md): Signals the end of a reasoning phase.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageChunk](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageChunk.md): Convenience event for reasoning messages.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageContent](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageContent.md): Delivers a piece of reasoning message content.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageEnd](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageEnd.md): Signals the end of a reasoning message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageStart](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningMessageStart.md): Signals the start of a reasoning message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningStart](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ReasoningStart.md): Signals the start of a reasoning phase.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.RunError](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.RunError.md): Signals an error during an agent run.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.RunFinished](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.RunFinished.md): Signals the successful completion of an agent run.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.RunStarted](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.RunStarted.md): Signals the start of an agent run.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.StateDelta](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.StateDelta.md): Delivers incremental state updates using JSON Patch (RFC 6902).
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.StateSnapshot](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.StateSnapshot.md): Delivers a complete snapshot of agent state.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.StepFinished](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.StepFinished.md): Signals the completion of a step within an agent run.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.StepStarted](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.StepStarted.md): Signals the start of a step within an agent run.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageChunk](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageChunk.md): Convenience event that auto-expands to Start/Content/End.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageContent](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageContent.md): Delivers a piece of text message content.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageEnd](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageEnd.md): Signals the end of a text message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageStart](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.TextMessageStart.md): Signals the start of a text message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingEnd](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingEnd.md): Signals the end of a thinking step.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingStart](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingStart.md): Signals the start of a thinking step.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingTextMessageContent](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingTextMessageContent.md): Delivers a piece of thinking text message content.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingTextMessageEnd](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingTextMessageEnd.md): Signals the end of a thinking text message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingTextMessageStart](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ThinkingTextMessageStart.md): Signals the start of a thinking text message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallArgs](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallArgs.md): Delivers tool call arguments.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallChunk](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallChunk.md): Convenience event for tool calls without explicit Start/End.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallEnd](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallEnd.md): Signals the end of a tool call.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallResult](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallResult.md): Delivers the result of a tool call execution.
  - [AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallStart](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Events.ToolCallStart.md): Signals the start of a tool call.

- Message Types
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.ActivityMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.ActivityMessage.md): An activity progress message emitted between chat messages.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.AssistantMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.AssistantMessage.md): An assistant message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.BaseMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.BaseMessage.md): Base message fields shared by all message types.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.BinaryInputContent](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.BinaryInputContent.md): A binary payload reference in a multimodal user message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.Context](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.Context.md): Additional context for the agent.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.DeveloperMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.DeveloperMessage.md): A developer message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.FunctionCall](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.FunctionCall.md): Name and arguments of a function call.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.ReasoningMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.ReasoningMessage.md): A reasoning message containing the agent's internal reasoning process.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.RunAgentInput](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.RunAgentInput.md): Input for running an agent.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.SystemMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.SystemMessage.md): A system message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.TextInputContent](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.TextInputContent.md): A text fragment in a multimodal user message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.Tool](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.Tool.md): A tool definition.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.ToolCall](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.ToolCall.md): A tool call, modelled after OpenAI tool calls.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.ToolMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.ToolMessage.md): A tool result message.
  - [AgUi.Core.Types.UserMessage](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Core.Types.UserMessage.md): A user message supporting text or multimodal content.

- Encoding
  - [AgUi.Encoder.EventEncoder](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Encoder.EventEncoder.md): Encodes AG-UI events to SSE (Server-Sent Events) format.

- Transport
  - [AgUi.Transport.Channel](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Transport.Channel.md): Phoenix Channel transport for AG-UI.
  - [AgUi.Transport.SSE](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Transport.SSE.md): Server-Sent Events (SSE) transport for AG-UI.

- State
  - [AgUi.State.Manager](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.State.Manager.md): AG-UI state management with snapshot/delta support.

- Middleware
  - [AgUi.Middleware.Pipeline](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Middleware.Pipeline.md): AG-UI middleware pipeline for event transformation and validation.

- Client
  - [AgUi.Client.HttpAgent](https://ag-ui-ex.hexdocs.pm/AgUi.Client.HttpAgent.md): HTTP client for consuming AG-UI event streams from remote agents.
